object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make a git repository with two committed documents, PARENT and CHILD, where CHILD-1 links to PARENT-1 and the link records its acknowledged commit. Overwrite CHILD's manifest with the single line '<<<<<<< HEAD', so CHILD can't be read. Run mellon-check with --repo-root naming the repository. Expected: exit status 1; a line holding LOAD_ERROR, the document ID CHILD, the file CHILD/CHILD.xml, line 1 and the reason; no validation error line for CHILD; PARENT is still checked.
